skills.description_zh:
把「逐个打开网页查看」变成「直接看图片」：批量对网址截图，默认整页长图，自动生成含最终跳转地址、标题、状态码、时间戳的留底元信息，适用于链接鉴别、网页证据存档、批量网页巡检。

功能介绍（详细说明）
- 批量截图省动作：一次给一批网址，自动逐个截图，无需人工逐个打开网页
- 整页长图：默认滚动到底截全页，懒加载内容也能截到，可切换为仅截首屏
- 留底元信息：每个网址附带一份 JSON，记录原始网址、最终跳转地址、页面标题、HTTP - 状态码、时间戳，是真正意义上的「证据留底」
- 安全护栏：无头模式、禁止下载、拦截弹窗、阻止新窗口、加载超时，打开陌生/可疑链接更安心
- 内网防护：访问内网/保留地址前自动告警，避免误访
- 防覆盖：文件名含图片 md5 指纹，同域名批量截图不会互相覆盖
- 开箱即用：内置一键安装脚本，系统已装 Edge/Chrome 时无需下载浏览器内核

skills.description: Decide and ship a crawl policy for generative-AI bots on a website — who to block, how to block them, and how to verify it worked. Use when the user says "block AI crawlers", "keep GPTBot out", "robots.txt AI training opt-out", "how do I write __usage_ai-training", "generate llms.txt", "AI scrapers are taking my content", "should my site opt out of AI training", "ai crawl policy". Capabilities: (1) a four-tier decision table — allow and ask for attribution, searchable-but-not-trainable, search and user-triggered only, full block — chosen by content shape and business model (2) a three-class crawler list: training, retrieval/citation, user-triggered, each with its UA token (3) the deliverable set: robots.txt block, llms.txt, X-Robots-Tag and meta, with nginx / Cloudflare / Vercel snippets (4) the three traps that silently void the config: the wildcard group does not match the training signal, opting out of training is not opting out of search, and neither stops citation in answers (5) scripts/robots_audit.py read-only audit: parse groups, simulate any UA as allow or deny, flag wildcard misuse and duplicate groups (6) a verification and rollback checklist. Do not trigger for: technical anti-scraping (WAF, CAPTCHA, IP bans, rate limits); legal advice; news reading.
skills.description_zh: 【Crawl Policy】Want AI training out but search traffic in? Pick one of four tiers, ship robots.txt plus llms.txt correctly the first time, then prove it with a simulation. Chinese version: ai-crawler-optout
skills.name: AI Crawl Policy
